catalog.content: Hourly and daily station measurements of global solar radiation (O-A0091-001), wind speed/gust, temperature and rainfall across Taiwan
catalog.note: Provides ground-truth Taiwan north-south solar gradient (2.2-2.6 vs 3.9-4.7 kWh/m2/day) for ERA5 bias correction

catalog.name_en: GSMMA GeoTEX Taiwan Geothermal Exploration Platform
catalog.name_zh: 經濟部地礦中心地熱探勘資訊平台 (GeoTEX)
catalog.provider: MOEA Geological Survey and Mining Management Agency (GSMMA)
catalog.content: 3D geological models, well logs (405 wells), temperature profiles, and 10 priority geothermal potential zones (~989 MW shallow, ~40 GW deep)
catalog.note: Summarised on docs/weather-re.html alongside model geothermal cap
